length_reference.basis: body + question + example; per language ~10 min; reference only

site_wait.note: live-check retries after the site commit (~22 min); the retry timer resumes later runs until send_deadline

editor.note: bounded editor loop per draft; drafts still open after max_attempts wait for a person. The fix/block threshold is never relaxed here.

final_editor.runtime: claude_cli (official Claude Code CLI on the Pi, claude.ai subscription)
final_editor.note: attempts are genuine editorial attempts (health failures not counted), counted since the last demotion from checked; each continues from the previous final text and open issues; a new attempt starts only if the job deadline leaves min_minutes_per_attempt; after max_attempts the draft stays pending. Thresholds are never relaxed.

context_review.note: normalised characters around each excerpt (more after than before), one bounded search round for long sources; see context.py
